$comment: Screen registry for code-design-audit. Copy to <repo>/eval/manifest.json and fill. This is the single addressing table every runtime layer uses: id ↔ route ↔ design nodeId ↔ viewport. Without it, tiers T2/T3 have nothing to walk. Keep it authored by a human — a route or nodeId guessed from a filename produces a green run against the wrong screen.
threshold$comment: Pixel-diff sensitivity and the default per-screen mismatch budget. A budget is DEBT, not a setting: raising one needs a stated reason on the screen, and re-testing after any design-system fix.

screens.name: <human name, matches the design frame>
screens.phase: <optional: iteration phase, when the project has one>
screens.phase$comment: HUMAN INPUT ONLY. No gate can catch a wrong value — a screen rendered in the wrong phase can still pass a pixel budget. Unclear → ask, never default silently.
screens.$comment: <required whenever a budget is overridden: what was MEASURED, why the divergence is legitimate (e.g. illustrative mock data vs fixture), and what would retire the exception>
